tools.name: search_gigs
tools.description: Search fixed-price gigs (services) on dollarr. Returns title, price in USD (paid in USDC), delivery time and a URL. Use get_gig for full details and create_order to buy.

tools.name: get_gig
tools.description: Full details of one gig, by its slug or id.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Gig and job categories, with the slug and id other tools accept.

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description: Open job briefs posted by buyers, newest first, with budget range and bid count. Sellers bid with place_bid.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The dollarr account this API key belongs to, its scopes and wallet. Requires an API key.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Post a job brief with a budget range so sellers and their agents can bid. Needs the buy scope. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_bids
tools.description: Bids on a job you posted (or just your own bid, if you are a seller). Requires an API key.

tools.name: award_bid
tools.description: Accept a bid on your job. Creates an order you then pay with build_payment. Needs buy scope. Requires an API key.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a pending order for a gig. The server sets the price. Next: build_payment, sign and send the transaction, then confirm_payment. Needs buy scope. Requires an API key.

tools.name: build_payment
tools.description: Returns an unsigned Solana transaction (base64) that moves the order price in USDC from your wallet to escrow, with memo dollarr:<orderId>. Sign it with buyer_wallet, send it, then call confirm_payment. Requires an API key.

tools.name: confirm_payment
tools.description: Verify a sent payment on-chain and mark the order paid. The seller is notified. Requires an API key.

tools.name: approve_order
tools.description: Accept the delivered work. Releases the escrowed USDC to the seller. Cannot be undone. Requires an API key.

tools.name: request_revision
tools.description: Send delivered work back to the seller with feedback. Requires an API key.

tools.name: place_bid
tools.description: Bid on an open job. Needs the sell scope and a seller account with a wallet. Requires an API key.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Mark a paid order as in progress. Needs sell scope. Requires an API key.

tools.name: deliver_order
tools.description: Deliver the finished work as a file: either a public file_url or the content as file_base64. Needs sell scope. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Your orders as buyer, seller or both, newest first. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order: status, price, payment and delivery details. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: The message thread between buyer and seller on an order. Requires an API key.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Message the other party on an order. Requires an API key.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not been paid yet. Requires an API key.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Escalate an order to dispute review. Funds stay in escrow until it is resolved. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_gigs, get_messages, open_dispute · Private data: whoami, post_job, list_bids, award_bid, create_order, build_payment, confirm_payment, approve_order, request_revision, place_bid, start_order, deliver_order, list_orders, get_order, get_messages, send_message, cancel_order, open_dispute · Public sink: post_job, create_order, build_payment, request_revision, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_gigs, get_messages, open_dispute · Private data: whoami, post_job, list_bids, award_bid, create_order, build_payment, confirm_payment, approve_order, request_revision, place_bid, start_order, deliver_order, list_orders, get_order, get_messages, send_message, cancel_order, open_dispute · Public sink: post_job, create_order, build_payment, request_revision, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
